name: FastH3 Omni
description: Community FastH3 Omni build of MiniMax H3 (reference-to-video+audio)
notes: FastH3 Omni (fasth3_omni_i4x.ckpt, server modifier 'ref2va'): 8 steps - NOT the 50-step MiniMax H3 default. CFG 1.0, DDIM Trailing, shift 12, 832x512. Accepts reference images. Up to 362 frames. Tiled decoding OFF: the tile settings in the phone-exported H3 preset reflect local hardware, not the model. 73 frames ~= 3s at 25fps.
